notes.title: STEAM DECKBUILDERS FEST!!!
notes.notes:
Hey lovely people! Long time no see 😁

We wanted to let you know that we'll be taking part of Steam Deckbuilders Fest from 25th March til 1st April!

With this, we're also adding the very first demo of the game so you can have an initial feel of the game.


We truly hope you enjoy it, and any feedback you feel relevant is more than welcome <3

Thanks for all the support and make sure to wishlist!
